title: Registration settings
description: Manage the cycle, shifts, tiers, Wasteland, alliances, and registration fields.

cycle.description: Automatic or manual registration opening and closing.

wasteland.title: Alliances and Wasteland
wasteland.description: Wasteland settings, alliances, and their rotation.

formFields.title: Registration form fields
formFields.description: Fields shown on the form and marked as required.

cycle.title: Registration cycle
cycle.description: Configure the automatic cycle or enter dates manually.
cycle.manualOpenFallback: If no date is set, use the automatic opening time
cycle.manualCloseFallback: If no date is set, use the automatic closing time
cycle.manualFallbackNote: A manual date has priority. If the field is empty and the checkbox is enabled, the automatic cycle date is used.

shiftsModal.title: Available shifts
shiftsModal.description: Enable the shifts available to players.

tiersModal.title: Available tiers
tiersModal.description: Enable the tiers available to players.

wastelandModal.title: Alliances and Wasteland
wastelandModal.alliancesEmpty: No alliances have been added yet.

formFieldsModal.title: Registration form fields
formFieldsModal.description: Choose which fields are shown and which are required.
formFieldsModal.customDescription: Add your own fields to the form.
formFieldsModal.customEmpty: No custom fields have been added yet.

errors.period: Closing time must be later than opening time.
errors.periodMissing: Enter valid opening and closing times.
errors.shiftRequired: At least one shift must remain available.
errors.tierRequired: At least one tier must remain available.
errors.cycleWindowClosed: A cycle may only be started or resumed within its registration window and before Wasteland begins. Check the cycle dates.

notifications.currentApplied: Settings were applied to the current cycle.
notifications.defaultsRestored: Default settings restored. Alliances and their rotation were not changed.

confirm.cycleDescription: Changing cycle dates or mode can create a new registration period when the opening time is reached.
confirm.cycleImmediateDescription: The new opening time has already been reached. Saving may create a new cycle with an empty player list.
confirm.cycleDetailPlayers: Current players are not deleted from the database, but a new cycle starts with 0 players.
confirm.cycleDetailHistory: The old cycle remains in history until it is automatically deleted after 30 days.
confirm.activeCycleTitle: The current cycle is already open
confirm.activeCycleDescription: Choose whether to save these rules only for the next cycle or also apply them to the current cycle.
confirm.tierExistingPlayers: Players with tiers that become unavailable remain in the current list. New registrations can no longer select those tiers.
confirm.shiftExistingPlayers: If you disable a shift that already has players, you must choose where those players should be moved.
confirm.formExistingPlayers: New form rules apply to new submissions. Existing submissions are not changed.
confirm.defaultsDescription: The standard cycle, shifts, tiers and form fields will be restored.
confirm.defaultsDetailRules: Default: Shift 1, Shift 2, Any shift; tiers T9–T14; standard form fields.
confirm.defaultsDetailAlliances: Alliances, names, rotation, host alliance and governor remain unchanged.
confirm.closeRegistrationDescription: Are you sure you want to close registration? New submissions will be rejected even while the registration period is still active.
confirm.closeRegistrationDetail: Existing registrations will remain in the player table. You can reopen registration using the same button.
confirm.openRegistrationDescription: Are you sure you want to allow new submissions?
confirm.openRegistrationDetail: Manual closure will be removed. Registration will still only be available within the configured cycle dates.
confirm.cycleActionTitle: What should happen to the cycle?
confirm.cycleActionContinueDetail: Keep all registrations, captains and existing assignments unchanged.
confirm.cycleActionNewDetail: Start a fresh empty cycle; previous registrations stay archived for 30 days. Not permitted after Wasteland begins.

shiftRemap.title: Move players between shifts
shiftRemap.description: Some players are registered in shifts you are disabling. Choose a new shift for each group.
